name: is_almost_quantum_of_is_commuting_quantum
lines: p : X → Y → A → B → ℝ
hA : ∀ (x_1 : X), (∀ (a : A), IsStarProjection (A_meas x_1 a)) ∧ ∑ a, A_meas x_1 a = 1
hB : ∀ (y : Y), (∀ (b : B), IsStarProjection (B_meas y b)) ∧ ∑ b, B_meas y b = 1
hcomm : ∀ (x_1 : X) (y : Y) (a : A) (b : B) (v : E), (A_meas x_1 a) ((B_meas y b) v) = (B_meas y b) ((A_meas x_1 a) v)
hp : ∀ (x_1 : X) (y : Y) (a : A) (b : B), p x_1 y a b = inner ℝ ψ ((A_meas x_1 a) ((B_meas y b) ψ))

steps.tactic: obtain ⟨E, x, x1, hcs, ψ, hψ, A_meas, hA, B_meas, hB, hcomm, hp⟩ := h
exact ⟨E, x, x1, hcs, ψ, hψ, A_meas, hA, B_meas, hB, fun x y a b => hcomm x y a b ψ, hp⟩
